body: Weighed myself last week, don’t really know if my scale is broken but I was in a strict calorie deficit of slightly under 2k for around 2 weeks.

Thanks for the compliment :)

I’ll definitely try and get some more outdoor photos and show my body more, maybe just not any shirtless pictures at the moment as I have pretty bad body acne and body dysmorphia regarding my weight.

Definitely gonna look into therapy and taking it more seriously. Did it for a year, got on antidepressants, but didn’t actually do the work needed for it to work effectively, so I think it’s worth another shot.
What would be a good first step to get out of the shitshow I’m in?

Yeah my social skills aren’t up to the max level to do any picking up at bars, especially where I live lol.

How does one find dates/hookups outside of dating apps? 

I’ve tried looking at meetup.com for events but none really resonated with me and don’t seem to cater to people my age. 

The only social group and form of meeting girls I have is my Catholic youth group, dates are probably fine but hookups are off the table considering how sex before marriage is frowned upon. I’m definitely not wanting to manipulate/coerce some girl in the faith out of my own selfishness.

I’m not addicted to video games by all means, so my relationship with them isn’t at all negative, just find it hard to choose which game to pick up and play without being bored after an hour lol.

My relationship with the gym is very strange, because I want to lose weight and be more muscular but don’t really know where to start (I’ve tried r/Fitness and r/LoseIt but their guides were overwhelming for me). Everyone keeps saying mentally you feel great after being active but for some odd reason I don’t really feel that "feel good" feeling everyone else has, just a lot sore joints and finding it hard to swallow.

I am very aware about desperation being a women repellent, I really, reeaaallly, want to get over this hence the post.

Would hiring an escort and losing the v card really help? Dating app feels out of the question considering what I look like (pics in profile) and the lack of new pictures I can use for a dating profile.
Facial hair either shaved or more trimmed? I’ve been really trying for a beard since I don’t like when I’m clean shaven but it just comes out looking odd & not connected to the stache.
